    <style>
        :root {
            --gsa-green: #006b3f;
            --gsa-green-dark: #063f2b;
            --gsa-gold: #f6d94a;
            --gsa-red: #c51d23;
            --gsa-ink: #101820;
            --gsa-muted: #5f6b68;
            --gsa-cream: #fbf8ef;
            --gsa-line: rgba(16, 24, 32, 0.1);
            --gsa-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(11, 37, 29, 0.14);
        }

        body {
            background: #fff;
        }

        .premium-home {
            font-family: Lato, Arial, sans-serif;
            color: var(--gsa-ink);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .premium-home * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        .premium-home a {
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .premium-container {
            width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 40px));
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .premium-eyebrow {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            color: var(--gsa-green);
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: 1.6px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .premium-eyebrow::before {
            content: "";
            width: 42px;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gsa-red), var(--gsa-gold), var(--gsa-green));
            border-radius: 999px;
        }

        .premium-section {
            padding: 92px 0;
        }

        .premium-section.alt {
            background: #f7f8f3;
        }

        .premium-section.dark {
            background:
                linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 63, 43, 0.96), rgba(6, 63, 43, 0.88)),
                url('/images/img/stats-background.jpeg') center/cover no-repeat;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .premium-section-head {
            max-width: 760px;
            margin-bottom: 42px;
        }

        .premium-section-head.center {
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .premium-section-head.center .premium-eyebrow {
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .premium-section h2,
        .premium-hero h1 {
            margin: 0;
            font-family: Raleway, Lato, Arial, sans-serif;
            color: inherit;
            letter-spacing: 0;
        }

        .premium-section h2 {
            font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 50px);
            line-height: 1.05;
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .premium-section-lede {
            margin: 18px 0 0;
            color: var(--gsa-muted);
            font-size: 17px;
            line-height: 1.75;
        }

        .premium-section.dark .premium-section-lede,
        .premium-section.dark .premium-eyebrow {
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
        }

        .premium-hero {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 760px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: stretch;
            background: var(--gsa-green-dark);
            color: #fff;
        }

        .premium-hero-slider {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .premium-hero-slide {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-position: center right;
            background-size: cover;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(1.04);
            transition: opacity 1s ease, transform 6s ease;
        }

        .premium-hero-slide.is-active {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        .premium-hero-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(5, 32, 23, 0.96) 0%, rgba(5, 32, 23, 0.78) 45%, rgba(5, 32, 23, 0.24) 100%),
                linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(5, 32, 23, 0.32), rgba(5, 32, 23, 0.08));
        }

        .premium-hero::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            height: 6px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gsa-red) 0 33%, var(--gsa-gold) 33% 66%, var(--gsa-green) 66% 100%);
        }

        .premium-hero-inner {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
            align-items: center;
            padding: 118px 0 98px;
        }

        .premium-hero-copy {
            display: grid;
            max-width: 820px;
        }

        .premium-hero-copy .premium-eyebrow {
            grid-area: 1 / 1;
        }

        .premium-hero-content {
            grid-area: 2 / 1;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transform: translateY(14px);
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: opacity 0.65s ease, transform 0.65s ease, visibility 0.65s ease;
        }

        .premium-hero-content.is-active {
            opacity: 1;
            pointer-events: auto;
            transform: translateY(0);
            visibility: visible;
        }

        .premium-hero h1 {
            max-width: 820px;
            font-size: clamp(46px, 6.5vw, 82px);
            line-height: 0.98;
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .premium-hero p {
            max-width: 650px;
            margin: 26px 0 0;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
            font-size: clamp(18px, 2.1vw, 22px);
            line-height: 1.65;
        }

        .premium-actions {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 14px;
            margin-top: 36px;
        }

        .premium-btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            min-height: 52px;
            padding: 15px 24px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: 0.8px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
        }

        .premium-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .premium-btn.primary {
            background: var(--gsa-gold);
            color: #111;
            box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(246, 217, 74, 0.25);
        }

        .premium-btn.dark {
            background: var(--gsa-green);
            color: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(0, 107, 63, 0.18);
        }

        .premium-btn.ghost {
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42);
            color: #fff;
        }

        .premium-btn.light {
            border: 1px solid var(--gsa-line);
            color: var(--gsa-green-dark);
            background: #fff;
        }

        .premium-hero-controls {
            position: absolute;
            z-index: 2;
            right: max(20px, calc((100vw - 1180px) / 2));
            top: 50%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 10px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: rgba(5, 32, 23, 0.22);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .premium-hero-arrow,
        .premium-hero-dot {
            border: 0;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
        }

        .premium-hero-arrow {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 24px;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .premium-hero-arrow:hover,
        .premium-hero-arrow:focus {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            outline: none;
        }

        .premium-hero-dots {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 9px;
        }

        .premium-hero-dot {
            width: 4px;
            height: 28px;
            padding: 0;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34);
        }

        .premium-hero-dot.is-active {
            background: var(--gsa-gold);
            transform: scaleY(1.18);
        }

        .premium-trust-strip {
            margin-top: -44px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .premium-trust-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            background: #fff;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--gsa-shadow);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .premium-stat {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            padding: 28px;
            border-right: 1px solid var(--gsa-line);
        }

        .premium-stat-icon {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex: 0 0 42px;
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(0, 107, 63, 0.1);
            color: var(--gsa-green);
            font-size: 17px;
        }

        .premium-stat-content {
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .premium-stat:last-child {
            border-right: 0;
        }

        .premium-stat strong {
            display: block;
            color: var(--gsa-green-dark);
            font-family: Raleway, Lato, Arial, sans-serif;
            font-size: 34px;
            line-height: 1;
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .premium-stat span {
            display: block;
            margin-top: 10px;
            color: var(--gsa-muted);
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.45;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .premium-opportunity-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
            gap: 24px;
        }

        .premium-opportunity-card {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            min-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid var(--gsa-line);
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(16, 24, 32, 0.08);
            color: var(--gsa-ink);
        }

        .premium-opportunity-card:hover {
            color: var(--gsa-ink);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .premium-opportunity-image {
            aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
            background: #e7ece5;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .premium-opportunity-image img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            display: block;
            object-fit: cover;
            transition: transform 0.35s ease;
        }

        .premium-opportunity-image img.is-placeholder {
            padding: 32px;
            object-fit: contain;
            background: #ffffff;
        }

        .premium-opportunity-card:hover img {
            transform: scale(1.04);
        }

        .premium-opportunity-body {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            flex: 1;
            padding: 24px;
        }

        .premium-opportunity-meta {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .premium-status-chip {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 24px;
            padding: 5px 9px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: rgba(0, 107, 63, 0.1);
            color: var(--gsa-green-dark);
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: 0.7px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .premium-status-chip.open {
            background: rgba(0, 107, 63, 0.1);
            color: var(--gsa-green-dark);
        }

        .premium-status-chip.closing {
            background: rgba(246, 217, 74, 0.28);
            color: #6a5200;
        }

        .premium-status-chip.closed {
            background: rgba(197, 29, 35, 0.1);
            color: #8a1217;
        }

        .premium-date {
            color: var(--gsa-green);
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: 0.8px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .premium-opportunity-body h3 {
            margin: 13px 0 0;
            color: var(--gsa-ink);
            font-size: 21px;
            line-height: 1.25;
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .premium-read-more {
            margin-top: auto;
            padding-top: 24px;
            color: var(--gsa-green);
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 900;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.8px;
        }

        .premium-route-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
            gap: 18px;
        }

        .premium-route-card {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            min-height: 250px;
            padding: 26px;
            border: 1px solid var(--gsa-line);
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #fff;
            color: var(--gsa-ink);
            box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(16, 24, 32, 0.06);
            transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
        }

        .premium-route-card:hover,
        .premium-pathway:hover {
            color: var(--gsa-ink);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .premium-route-card:hover,
        .premium-pathway:hover,
        .premium-faq-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 22px 46px rgba(16, 24, 32, 0.1);
        }

        .premium-route-icon {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 46px;
            height: 46px;
            margin-bottom: 22px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(246, 217, 74, 0.3);
            color: var(--gsa-green-dark);
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .premium-route-card h3 {
            margin: 0;
            color: var(--gsa-green-dark);
            font-size: 20px;
            line-height: 1.2;
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .premium-route-card p {
            margin: 15px 0 0;
            color: var(--gsa-muted);
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.65;
        }

        .premium-route-link {
            margin-top: auto;
            padding-top: 22px;
            color: var(--gsa-green);
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: 0.8px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .premium-pathways {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
            gap: 18px;
        }

        .premium-pathway {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 286px;
            padding: 26px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #fff;
            border: 1px solid var(--gsa-line);
            box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(16, 24, 32, 0.06);
            color: var(--gsa-ink);
            transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
        }

        .premium-pathway::before {
            content: "";
            display: block;
            width: 46px;
            height: 5px;
            margin-bottom: 22px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gsa-red), var(--gsa-gold), var(--gsa-green));
        }

        .premium-pathway h3 {
            margin: 0;
            color: var(--gsa-green-dark);
            font-size: 20px;
            line-height: 1.2;
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .premium-pathway p {
            margin: 16px 0 0;
            color: var(--gsa-muted);
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.75;
        }

        .premium-feature {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
            gap: 58px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .premium-photo-stack {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 560px;
        }

        .premium-photo-main,
        .premium-photo-small {
            position: absolute;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--gsa-shadow);
            background: #ddd;
        }

        .premium-photo-main {
            inset: 0 72px 72px 0;
        }

        .premium-photo-small {
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 46%;
            height: 260px;
            border: 8px solid #fff;
        }

        .premium-photo-main img,
        .premium-photo-small img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            display: block;
            object-fit: cover;
        }

        .premium-copy-card {
            padding: 42px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #fff;
            box-shadow: var(--gsa-shadow);
            border: 1px solid var(--gsa-line);
        }

        .premium-copy-card p {
            margin: 18px 0 0;
            color: var(--gsa-muted);
            font-size: 16px;
            line-height: 1.8;
        }

        .premium-steps {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
            gap: 18px;
            margin-top: 42px;
        }

        .premium-step {
            padding: 28px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
        }

        .premium-step span {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;
            margin-bottom: 22px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--gsa-gold);
            color: #101820;
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .premium-step h3 {
            margin: 0;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 20px;
            line-height: 1.2;
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .premium-step p {
            margin: 14px 0 0;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76);
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .premium-prep-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
            gap: 28px;
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .premium-safety-card,
        .premium-checklist-card,
        .premium-faq-card {

                    setActive(activeIndex + 1);
                }, delay);
            }

            dots.forEach(function (dot) {
                dot.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    setActive(parseInt(dot.getAttribute('data-premium-hero-dot'), 10));
                    start();
                });
            });

            if (previous) {
                previous.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    setActive(activeIndex - 1);
                    start();
                });
            }

            if (next) {
                next.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    setActive(activeIndex + 1);
                    start();
                });
            }

            slider.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
            slider.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
            slider.addEventListener('focusin', stop);
            slider.addEventListener('focusout', start);

            start();
        }());
    </script>
